scene: The capsule pops open, revealing a sparkling transit pass for three distant districts.
picture: Flat side view of a bustling multi-transit terminal platform. On the far left, a maglev dragon train idles with glowing doors open. The young Chinese woman in a red bomber jacket stands centre on roller skates, holding an open capsule. Up high hangs a round cable pod, while on the far right floats a solar-sail junk.
shown: a sleek maglev dragon train waiting with open doors on the left track
a round cloud cable pod dangling ready from an overhead wire up high
a wooden solar-sail junk moored at the open water dock on the far right
